title: SCILLA PASSIVE: Cue-Driven Opportunistic Maritime Verification Using Non-Cooperative Merchant-Radar Illumination
description: Reproducible simulation release evaluating cue-driven opportunistic passive maritime second observations using moving non-cooperative merchant-radar illuminators. The evidence supports a measurement-architecture hypothesis but does not demonstrate a donor-selection optimizer moat. No measured RF performance, operational detection range, patentability, customer traction, or acquisition interest is claimed.
